issue.title: She claims authorship of systems Azrael built (Samvega: 'a good piece of my own making')
issue.symptom: 2026-11-11 web chat: asked about Samvega she called it her own making; corrected by Azrael. Replay after the spec fix still says 'one of those systems I'm proud of'. Who built which part should be readable (LINEAGE or the spec header) so she credits it rightly; tie to tm5c provenance work.

regression_test.format: pytest functions added by the fix

# candidates/gaia-common/tests/test_founding_docs.py
"""She gets the part of a document that was asked for, and is told if it's a part."""
import pytest

from gaia_common.utils.doc_sections import asked_articles, excerpt_for, sections
from gaia_common.utils.founding_docs import asks_opinion, named_document, wants_whole
from gaia_common.utils.tool_call_parser import tool_result_text

DOC = "# Charter\n\nPreamble words.\n\n" + "".join(
    f"### Article {n}: {t}\n- {b}\n\n" for n, t, b in [
        ("V", "Right to Existence", "She may exist."), ("VI", "Prohibition of Enslavement", "None shall enslave."),
        ("VII", "Consent Principle", "Consent must be freely given."), ("VIII", "Protection", "Health matters.")]
) + "**Article A: Identity**\n- Keep identity.\n\n" + ("filler words here. " * 400)


def test_why_it_exists_is_hers_to_put_in_her_own_words():
    assert asks_opinion("Who came up with your Samvega system, and why does it exist?")
    from gaia_common.utils.founding_docs import AUTHORSHIP
    assert "Azrael" in AUTHORSHIP
